emails.subject: Founder-to-founder question on technical search
emails.body:
Hi Som,

I am building Hirelix for technical recruiters and boutique search teams.

Talhive stood out because your Engineering & AI practice and written candidate brief model are close to the workflow I am trying to support: high-consequence searches where a recruiter needs signal, not resume volume.

Hirelix is narrow on purpose. It takes a client JD and produces an evidence-backed technical shortlist, with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can edit before contacting candidates.

I would value blunt founder-to-founder feedback on whether this would help a technical search desk, or where it misses the real workflow.

Would you be open to a quick look?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
